description: Backstop deny-list for Azure DevOps credentials (CFS package feeds in tabs, ADR 20261105-cfs-package-feeds-in-tabs). A tab's CFS credential is bound to GET on the exact feed read paths; this denies, by provider name or host, any credentialed call that could mint or manage a credential (the REST API under _apis at any depth, including PATs, token sessions and feed management) or write to a feed (publish, unlist, delete) under _packaging at any depth, including the organisation-in-hostname form. Paths are matched case-insensitively against the canonical path, with a trailing slash and trailing dots or whitespace in each segment removed.

source.note: Azure DevOps REST API reference. Feed URLs and the package-feed layout are from example-org/internal-feed-docs docs/package-feeds.md at 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (private; cited by path).

redirects.reason: Package downloads from a CFS feed answer 303 with a read-only, ~1 hour SAS URL on a vsblobprodcus<NNN> Azure Storage account (measured 2026-11-06 through a real tab, EDR 20261106-cfs-feeds-tabd). The broker follows it itself so the tab never needs, or gets, any reach to Azure Storage, where anyone can create an account: the target comes from the credentialed feed response, never from the tab.

deny.reason: Azure DevOps REST API, at any depth (organisation, project or team scope, or none on organisation-in-hostname and service hosts): PAT lifecycle, token sessions, identities https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/tokens/pats

Azure DevOps REST API (see above), including feed management (POST feeds.dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_apis/packaging/feeds) https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/artifacts/feed-management
Writes to a feed, at any depth (see below)

Writes to a feed, at any depth including {org}.pkgs.visualstudio.com/_packaging/...: npm publish is a PUT on the registry path, PyPI upload a POST, unpublish a DELETE https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/artifacts/npm/publish
